long_biography.plain_text:
Patty Rude helped turn Youtheory's collagen supplements into a wider American wellness brand. She and Darren saw retailers making more room for supplements as grocery space contracted and decided to offer a broader set of products. Patty had worked in accounting; at Youtheory she directed finance and purchasing while the pair shared decisions across the business.

The company kept formulation and manufacturing in-house, expanding beyond collagen to turmeric, probiotics and other supplements. Patty described their early operation as a two-person venture and made product integrity central to its public identity. By the time Jamieson Wellness bought Nutrawise, the company behind Youtheory, it had grown into an established consumer-health manufacturer. Patty joined Darren as a named seller and agreed to work with the buyer after the transaction.
